create_bias_module: create a snt.Bias module that adds a learned bias tensor to inputs with configurable broadcast dimensions
create_bias_scalar: create a scalar bias module by passing an empty bias_dims list to snt.Bias
create_bias_last_dim: create a bias module that applies learned bias only over the last non-minibatch dimension using bias_dims=[-1]
create_bias_with_multiplier: create a bias module and subtract it from inputs using multiplier=-1 then reconstruct the original input
build_calculate_bias_shape: build a bias shape tuple from input shape and bias_dims, stripping leading unit dimensions and excluding the minibatch dimension
